H=W=22
g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
def place(cells,color,dr=0,dc=0):
    for r,c in cells:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W): print('oob',color,rr,cc); continue
        if g[rr][cc] not in (0,2,color): print('collision',rr,cc,g[rr][cc],color)
        g[rr][cc]=color
# Colored cells and marker coordinates per identified pieces
obj4=[(r,c) for r in range(8,11) for c in range(9,12)]
m4=[(7,10),(9,12),(11,9),(11,11)]
obj9=[(2,1),(2,5)]+[(3,c) for c in range(1,6)]
m9=[(1,1),(1,5)]
obj8=[(3,c) for c in range(16,20)]+[(4,19),(5,19)]+[(6,c) for c in range(16,20)]
m8=[(3,15),(6,15)]
obj6=[(13,c) for c in range(2,8)]+[(r,c) for r in range(14,18) for c in (2,7) if not (r==16 and c==2)]+[(18,c) for c in range(5,8)]
m6=[(14,8),(16,2),(18,4)]
obj3=[(r,c) for r in (18,19) for c in (16,18)]+[(20,c) for c in range(15,20)]

place(obj4,4);place(obj9,9,14,7);place(obj8,8,2,1);place(obj6,6,-9,8);place(obj3,3,-6,-7)
for coords,shift in [(m4,(0,0)),(m9,(14,7)),(m8,(2,1)),(m6,(-9,8)),(m3,(-6,-7))]:
    for r,c in coords:
        rr,cc=r+shift[0],c+shift[1]
        if g[rr][cc] and g[rr][cc]!=2: print('marker overlaps color',rr,cc,g[rr][cc])

print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
